source_law.text: The driver of any truck or combination of vehicles 80 inches or more in overall width, which is following a truck, or combination of vehicles 80 inches or more in overall width, shall, whenever conditions permit, leave a space of 500 feet so that an overtaking vehicle may enter and occupy such space without danger, but this shall not prevent a truck or combination of vehicles from overtaking and passing any vehicle or combination of vehicles. This subsection does not apply to any vehicle or combination of vehicles while moving on a highway on which there are two or more lanes available for traffic moving in the same direction.

requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Authored Native two-truck/Core/four-camera capture proposal, 480-frame source-hashed saved positives and negatives, source-based measured fallback trigger proofs, eight exact pinned offline and synthetic v1 portable positive/negative bundles, contracts and independent audits pass. Original Native behavior and physical conditions remain later GPU checks. Strict selected v2, independent delivery acceptance and branch closure remain worker-owned CPU work.

The same-cell one-lane hill-crest 480-frame synthetic hold/pass pair measures opposing-lane use, clearance, overtake and return, with an independent controlled comparison. Both hold and passing Native proposals have four distinct fallback requests and source-hashed measured thresholds. Their full saved positives and removed-source negatives, four decoded videos, source-bound measurement outputs, 28-bundle C102372 exact offline/v1 portable matrix and independent source/receipt audits pass. Selected v2 delivery acceptance, physical opposing-traffic clearance and a legal verdict remain unfinished.

Same-cell authored four-meter hill crest with two right-side same-direction lanes passes pinned map parsing. The two-lane Native proposal passes four-variant CPU preflight. Source-hashed 480-frame synthetic fixtures measure the 140 m gap and all three fallback trigger thresholds, check four saved videos, and pass positive/removed-source negatives. Four exact unselected candidate bundles pass pinned offline and v1 portable checks with independent receipt audits. A one-lane/two-lane controlled comparison holds truck rows and crest profile fixed. Selected v2 delivery acceptance, Native execution and physical highway-lane availability remain unfinished.

requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: The same-cell synthetic steady/lead-braking 480-frame controlled pair measures stopped-obstacle presence, lead/ego speed drops and road-surface gap compression across 500 feet. Both cases now have four Native requests, six source-hashed measured fallback thresholds, full saved positives and removed-source negatives, four decoded videos, source-bound measurement outputs, exact offline/v1 portable receipts within the 28-bundle C102372 matrix and independent controlled/source/receipt audits. Physical conditions permitting, selected v2 delivery acceptance and a legal verdict remain unfinished.
